FOR FAMILIES

Less pressure.
More shared moments.

Every child has their own interests and rhythm. Build a supportive practice routine around comfort, curiosity and connection.

01 / GET COMFORTABLE

Start with curiosity.

Introduce the equipment gradually. Let your child explore at a comfortable pace and use adult supervision throughout. Follow device age guidance and obtain suitability advice when needed.

02 / KEEP IT FLEXIBLE

Follow their rhythm.

Choose achievable goals and allow breaks. Stop if your child feels dizzy, uncomfortable or distressed. A supporting professional can help adapt practice to sensory needs.

03 / BRING IT OUTSIDE VR

Share real-life practice.

Use a related everyday activity after a virtual task: name feelings in a story, take turns in a game or explore a familiar routine together. Notice comfort and participation alongside task scores.

Wellness support, together.

LumiBrain™ is presented here as a wellness and skill-practice experience. It does not replace individual professional support. Calling a product wellness does not establish its regulatory status; availability and permitted uses vary by market.
